title: On Venus, One Spin Takes Longer Than a Year
description: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to spin once, but only about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun. And it spins backwards.

scenes.subject: venus
scenes.text: On Venus, you'd celebrate a birthday before a single day is over.
scenes.say: [laughs] On Venus, you'd celebrate a birthday before a single day is over.

scenes.subject: venus
scenes.text: Our closest neighbor spins so slowly
scenes.say: Our closest neighbor spins so slowly
